common: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an exceptionally clear 4K 3840x2560 art-direction sheet containing FOUR complete game detail-window screenshots arranged 2 by 2, with equal quadrants and a narrow neutral gutter. Each quadrant is one distinct tab state, not four panels inside one actual screen. Game: 风云南北朝, Chinese sixth-century historical strategy RPG. All quadrant text must be sharp simplified Chinese, not gibberish. Use concise labels rather than dense prose. Each quadrant has a small numbered title OUTSIDE the UI at its upper left, and inside a single clear main title, one horizontal navigation row, selected tab ivory brush highlight, consistent small back and X controls, fixed footer for current selected object's actions. Each shows a full usable viewport, never a cropped fragment. Palette: charcoal ink #121815, muted green #213128, ivory paper #ded2b4, antique gold #b39a62, restrained cinnabar #984f41. Irregular black ink-brush outer silhouette, flat hand-painted ink-and-wash small portraits, city/estate/office scenes, delicate gold separators, deep ink text on paper. Same visual family as a painted character dossier and illustrated city-building panel. No shiny beveled frames, no modern admin dashboard, no pills, no KPI tile grid, no glass, no gratuitous charts, no fake decorative progress. Do not use gigantic portraits or panorama at expense of content. Small scene vignette in header, about 15% height; object image as navigation entry, compact actual facts before actions. Background map glimpse optional in narrow outer margin. Body text must be readable at enlarged view. Aim for 16px-equivalent body, 28px-equivalent title; text content limited to the supplied labels plus short contextual lines. Each quadrant footer carries tiny 方案预览 · 数据示意. Numbers, characters and relations are illustrative design data; do not invent long historical explanations. Readable UI over decoration. No operating system/browser chrome, no English labels. Information density must feel complete yet ordered. Do not draw nested rows of tabs. Parameters and confirmation controls appear only when requested. Show meaningful object selection clearly. Four states:

boards.title: 政务
boards.spec:
TOP LEFT labeled 01 政务·要务: navigation 要务 差事 议事 朝廷, selected 要务. Header 萧衍 · 梁君主 / 建康. Left compact document inbox two rows 待批拨款 and 官员考课 with official portraits and tiny seals. Right selected document 丹阳赈济, small granary drawing, three brief facts 地方公粮 / 承办人 / 待裁定, concise consequence 暂缓将延后开仓. Footer 查看城邑 and 拟定处置. No invented actual execution.
TOP RIGHT labeled 02 政务·差事: same nav selected 差事. Narrow task list 巡察丹阳 在办, 修缮城仓 待核准, 抚恤流民 已结案. Right selected 修缮城仓 with city sketch and responsible official portrait. Horizontal stages 委任—赴任—办理—结案, indicate 待核准 before assignment, not false progress. Facts 经费来源 地方公库 / 承办人 待选 / 工期 预估30日. Concise risk 在途与公务可能顺延. Footer 查看详情 / 委任差事.
BOTTOM LEFT labeled 03 政务·议事: same nav selected 议事. Header 本季施政. Three compact illustrated mutually-exclusive choices 安民, 理财, 整军 arranged horizontally on paper with 安民 selected, each carries two comparable short lines 所得 and 取舍. Lower right two real-style official portraits with 意见已呈; concise status 尚未议定. Footer 预览议案 as only primary. No action sent by selection.
BOTTOM RIGHT labeled 04 政务·朝廷入口: same nav selected 朝廷, no second tab row. Refined dim painted palace hall occupying middle 40%, small role portraits 君位 / 掌政 / 中枢 / 继任 around functional seats; bottom three pictorial destination entries 朝会, 官署, 财赋 with symbols and one line roles. Current role 萧衍 · 君主. A slim section 本朝待办 contains 任职与继承 查看, not fake notices. Footer 进入朝会. This is a scene gateway; the detailed court navigation replaces this government navigation after entering.

boards.title: 邦交：国情／外交／世族／宣称
boards.spec:
All four nav 国情 外交 世族 宣称 往事, each highlights its own tab. Small 西魏 flag and 元宝炬 miniature painted ruler portrait, clear 仅查看／依权限交涉 implied by specific actions.
TOP LEFT 05 邦交·国情: selected 国情. Small ruler and executive portraits on left, labels 君主 元宝炬, 掌政 宇文泰. Right painted 长安 vignette, status 独立政权, 法理与实控 separate labelled rows 法理辖县 32 / 实控辖县 30 marked 示例. Plain unboxed groups 国体 / 朝局 / 国库 show values, and compact 有2县失守. Footer 查看朝廷 and 地图定位 (no gold execute).
TOP RIGHT 06 邦交·外交: selected 外交. Top bilateral flags 梁 and 西魏 with status 和平 / 关系 +12. Active treaties paper strip 安全通行 · 余120日 with clear direction. Middle compact 2-column illustrated action groups 礼仪往来 with 修好 会盟, 通行往来 with 通行 借道, 军事合作 with 同盟 军援, 宗属交涉 with 朝贡 独立. Lower actual-style envoy row 使团返程 · 余8日. Selecting action shown 修好, footer 查看交涉条件. Avoid giant blank inactive relationship categories.
BOTTOM LEFT 07 邦交·世族: selected 世族. Short comparison roster three families 宇文氏 独孤氏 元氏 with small distinct family insignia and patriarch portraits. Columns 声望 / 主要任职 / 与朝廷关系 in elegant paper register, not generic cards. Selected 宇文氏 shows household leader portrait and two connected office holders as a small family strip; label 权势来自任职与成员. Footer 查看族长 and 查看家族. No family trait icons.
BOTTOM RIGHT 08 邦交·宣称: selected 宣称. Left list named existing-style claim 继承资格 / 宗室身份 / 执政议案. Right shows portrait of selected claimant and clear text 宣称持有人 / 对象 / 依据 / 当前状态. Real-style lines 元氏宗室, 资格待核, 公开主张, not fake conquest. Bottom contrasting legal position and actual authority 法理身份 / 实际掌权 separated, short 支持不等于兵权. Footer 查看持有人 / 查看相关议案.

boards.title: 邦交：往事及交涉预览
boards.spec:
TOP LEFT 09 邦交·往事: full regular dossier nav 国情 外交 世族 宣称 往事 selected 往事. Two clearly sectioned chronological columns 承统沿革 and 外交往来 with portraits and small wax seals, date headings 546年 正月 and 545年 冬. Rows 登位记录, 互遣使团, 通行条约届满; short one-line consequences and clickable person/realm names. Compact object header 西魏. Footer 返回国情, no execution.
TOP RIGHT 交涉预览·修好: an independent parchment action dialog, title 修好 · 西魏, no page tabs. Compact bilateral flags, selected envoy portrait and row 使者 待择. Three labelled facts 出资 中央公款 / 影响力 本人 / 预计往返 按路线核对. Paper summary 预期 两国关系改善 / 风险 抵达后重新核验. Lower clear 状态 尚未派遣. Fixed footer 取消 and 确认派遣. No false probability displayed if envoy not selected.
BOTTOM LEFT 使者选择: an object-picker within existing confirmation workflow, title 择使 · 前往长安. Search field 输入姓名. Three painted portrait rows, each name, 外交, 专长, 到达时间, busy candidate visibly disabled with 正在办理差事. One selected outline. Right selected portrait with comparison 赴都12日 / 交涉8日 / 返程另计; label 示例. Footer 返回 and 选用此人. Choosing only edits draft.
BOTTOM RIGHT 宣战预览: parchment confirmation with title 对西魏宣战; selected target by name city 弘农 and flag, options 单城 州郡 吞并 shown as single radio choices, 单城 selected. Clear columns 战争目标 / 所需代价 / 外交后果. Strong legal caveat 仅此战目标，不含第三国. Short treaty warning 当前停战将受影响. Footer 取消 and subdued red 确认宣战, this is a preview only. Do not fabricate exact numeric costs.

boards.title: 军事
boards.spec:
All tabs 军情 军队 将领 战事, with one corresponding tab highlighted.
TOP LEFT 10 军事·军情: muted camp header 梁军务. Primary alert document 京口军粮不足 with tiny commander portrait and source 第2军, text 携粮不足十日, 粮道待核. Below another row 军职自荐 待裁定. Compact ongoing war ribbon 本国参战1场 marked 示例, most area meaningful chosen alert consequences and location drawing. Footer 查看军队 / 拟定补给. No huge numeric dashboard.
TOP RIGHT 11 军事·军队: left 30% roster 第一军 第二军 私人部曲, commander portraits and location labels, first selected. Right identity 第一军 · 驻留建康, small commander portrait, summary 兵力2400 / 士气70 / 携粮12日. Three painted regiment cards 长枪步兵 盾甲步兵 骑兵. Below supply strip 粮运 常规 / 粮队在途 4日, progress only actual illustrative status. Footer 行军 / 任将 / 粮运, primary 拟定军令 contextual. Detailed logistics only for selected army.
BOTTOM LEFT 12 军事·将领: main portrait register in compact two-column rows, each half-bust correctly proportioned plus name and military competency, 当前任军 and 所在地. Include 羊侃 / 韦粲 / 王僧辩 as illustrative portraits, no fixed historical appointment claims. Selected commander right miniature dossier 军事12 / 历练40 / 驻留建康 marked 示例. Show one specific empty army seat 统帅空缺 on lower ribbon, action 前往任将. Footer 查看人物 / 研习兵法, no direct appointment through a plain dropdown.
BOTTOM RIGHT 13 军事·战事: war selected 梁—西魏, battlefield map thumbnail occupies 20%, participants shown flags, status 进行中 and separate 战争目标 弘农 / 占领范围 / 谈判状态. A short siege card 城防尚存 / 援军消息待核, columns 本军损失 / 对军损失 marked 示例. Below short historical list 最近战斗 and a captive portrait row 俘虏待处置. Footer 查看战争 / 拟定议和. Do not give guaranteed acceptance or imply third-party territory transfer.

First three regular court pages use ONLY tabs 朝会 派系 官署 朝局 国策 财赋 纪事 with current one highlighted, title 梁 · 朝廷 and 返回政务. Fourth is an independent action preview.
TOP LEFT 28 朝廷·国策: selected 国策. Current 国体 贤能制 and 当前施政 守成 in modest paper ribbon. Three grouped illustrated policy sections 任用准则 / 制度通道 / 赋役落实; each current short choice plus 查看方案 affordance. Selected policy right shows 所得 / 代价 / 前提 / 生效范围 as 4 comparable lines. Faint palace mural behind header only. Footer 比较方案 / 拟定调整. Do not imply policy changes on selecting a card.
TOP RIGHT 29 朝廷·财赋: selected 财赋. Central treasury explicitly labeled 中央公库, slim facts 公款600 / 公粮1000 marked 示例. Avoid giant numerals and charts. Paper spread left recent budget 预计收入 / 预计支出 / 可用余额 separately from actual; right named 地方请款 docket 丹阳郡 修仓 with responsible officer small face. Lower entries 拨款待批 and 收支账簿 and 公款查核 as three in-body section links not another tab strip. Footer 查核账目 / 拟定拨款. No private money here.
BOTTOM LEFT 30 朝廷·纪事: selected 纪事. Official register with chronological dates, entries 任免 / 承统 / 国策 / 政务 showing a small seal, person or institution, concise consequence. Two columns 日期与事件 and selected record详情, not modern activity feed bubbles. Header 本朝记录 distinguishes this from global diary. Selected record 任职变动 with predecessor and successor portrait arrow, affects actual office only. Footer 查看人物 / 查看相关官署.
BOTTOM RIGHT 拨款预览: title 向丹阳郡拨款, warm paper action dialog with paired named wallets 来源 中央公库 / 去向 丹阳郡公库, arrows show transfer not income generation. Input 金额 100钱 with up/down controls, 用途 修缮城仓. Small official portrait 承办人 待确认. Summary 转出后 中央500 / 转入后 地方700 marked 示例. Approval chain 现任主管核准 and clear 支出与去向对应. Fixed footer 取消 / 确认拨款. No third account or automatic grant claim.
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce an exceptionally clear 4K 3840x2560 art-direction sheet containing FOUR complete game detail-window screenshots arranged 2 by 2, with equal quadrants and a narrow neutral gutter. Each quadrant is one distinct tab state, not four panels inside one actual screen. Game: 风云南北朝, Chinese sixth-century historical strategy RPG. All quadrant text must be sharp simplified Chinese, not gibberish. Use concise labels rather than dense prose. Each quadrant has a small numbered title OUTSIDE the UI at its upper left, and inside a single clear main title, one horizontal navigation row, selected tab ivory brush highlight, consistent small back and X controls, fixed footer for current selected object's actions. Each shows a full usable viewport, never a cropped fragment. Palette: charcoal ink #121815, muted green #213128, ivory paper #ded2b4, antique gold #b39a62, restrained cinnabar #984f41. Irregular black ink-brush outer silhouette, flat hand-painted ink-and-wash small portraits, city/estate/office scenes, delicate gold separators, deep ink text on paper. Same visual family as a painted character dossier and illustrated city-building panel. No shiny beveled frames, no modern admin dashboard, no pills, no KPI tile grid, no glass, no gratuitous charts, no fake decorative progress. Do not use gigantic portraits or panorama at expense of content. Small scene vignette in header, about 15% height; object image as navigation entry, compact actual facts before actions. Background map glimpse optional in narrow outer margin. Body text must be readable at enlarged view. Aim for 16px-equivalent body, 28px-equivalent title; text content limited to the supplied labels plus short contextual lines. Each quadrant footer carries tiny 方案预览 · 数据示意. Numbers, characters and relations are illustrative design data; do not invent long historical explanations. Readable UI over decoration. No operating system/browser chrome, no English labels. Information density must feel complete yet ordered. Do not draw nested rows of tabs. Parameters and confirmation controls appear only when requested. Show meaningful object selection clearly. Four states: First three regular court pages use ONLY tabs 朝会 派系 官署 朝局 国策 财赋 纪事 with current one highlighted, title 梁 · 朝廷 and 返回政务. Fourth is an independent action preview.

intrigueCorrection: Edit this four-quadrant Chinese historical strategy UI concept sheet. Preserve the entire layout, palette, text sizes, all tab bars, all borders and all content in the top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right quadrants exactly. Only change ONE known-target display in the TOP-LEFT quadrant titled 14 谋略·筹划: this is the player's own active befriending scheme, so the target is KNOWN. Replace the black silhouette and the ??? underneath the 目标人物 portrait with a clear hand-painted sixth-century Chinese official portrait and the readable name 韦粲. Keep the portrait size exactly equal to the adjacent 萧衍 portrait; keep the link arrow, progress 40%, 62% chance and 15% exposure unchanged. The blank selection silhouettes in the BOTTOM-RIGHT draft dialog are intentional and must remain. Do not add any new labels, interfaces, facts, decorative slogans or alter any other content.
